fields.label: Number of trials
fields.help_text: Accepted-response goal for the finite teaching/original path; fixed mode derives its own count from levels, conditions and repetitions.

fields.label: Fixation time
fields.help_text: Scheduled fixation phase duration before the stimulus, in milliseconds; this is not a measured photon-onset duration.

fields.label: Line presentation time
fields.help_text: Scheduled stimulus exposure duration in milliseconds; changing it changes the trial timeline, not measured display qualification.

fields.label: Blank time
fields.help_text: Scheduled gap between the declared stimulus intervals, in milliseconds; only timeline phases using this setting are affected.

fields.label: Response timeout (0 waits)
fields.help_text: Time allowed for a valid response in milliseconds; zero waits without a timeout. Timeout is an incomplete response, not an invented answer.

fields.label: Contrast selection method
fields.help_text: Original (if offered) preserves the previous teaching task. Adaptive updates strength; constant stimuli draws fixed strength levels.

fields.label: Line digital increment above grey background levels
fields.help_text: Comma-separated digital modulation/increment levels, not measured optical luminance contrast.

fields.label: Presentations per strength level per scientific condition
fields.help_text: Presentations of each selected strength level in each scientific condition. Total planned responses also multiply by the number of conditions and levels.

fields.label: Starting adaptive digital strength
fields.help_text: Digital modulation or increment as declared by the experiment.

fields.label: Maximum planned responses (safety ceiling)
fields.help_text: Accepted-response safety ceiling used by the selected adaptive/fixed method. Fixed plans exceeding it are rejected; adaptive stopping at this ceiling does not establish threshold convergence.

fields.label: Correct answers before decreasing strength
fields.help_text: Consecutive correct responses required before a downward strength step. Increasing this count delays downward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Incorrect answers before increasing strength
fields.help_text: Consecutive incorrect responses required before an upward strength step. Increasing this count delays upward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Down-step multiplier
fields.help_text: Multiplicative strength factor for an eligible downward step; the selected method enforces its lower strength bound.

fields.label: Up-step multiplier
fields.help_text: Multiplicative strength factor for an eligible upward step; the selected method enforces its upper strength bound.

fields.label: Response keys (in alternative order: left, right)
fields.help_text: Keys assigned in the displayed response-alternative order. Changing a key changes input mapping, not which alternative is scientifically correct.

scientific_spec.response: Two named alternatives; target/response alternative equality.
scientific_spec.quantity: Teaching stimulus digital commands and geometry; no calibrated optical threshold claim.
scientific_spec.conditions: Explicit condition order in make_conditions; shuffled only where its seed is declared.
scientific_spec.stopping: Configured accepted response count, not a threshold convergence criterion.
scientific_spec.exclusions: No retrospective deletion; timeout/abort/error preserved as run status.

fields.label: Spatial frequencies (cpd; select at least 8 for a full CSF)
fields.help_text: Carrier spatial frequencies to test, in cycles per visual degree. Each selected frequency is a scientific condition; larger values require finer display sampling.

fields.label: Contrast selection method
fields.help_text: Select adaptive staircases (unchanged) or fixed contrast levels. Both use the same spatial-frequency conditions and saved trial table.

fields.label: Fixed digital peak-to-peak contrast levels
fields.help_text: Constant stimuli only. Comma-separated digital grating modulation (not calibrated luminance contrast). Zero is an intentional catch level; levels must be distinct and within the selected background's digital gamut.

fields.label: Presentations per contrast level per scientific condition
fields.help_text: Each selected spatial frequency is a scientific condition. Each condition and contrast-level pair receives this many presentations; conditions can mean something else in other experiments. The max_trials field is a configurable safety ceiling.

fields.label: Fixation duration
fields.help_text: Scheduled fixation phase duration before the stimulus, in milliseconds; this is not a measured photon-onset duration.

fields.label: Grating duration
fields.help_text: Scheduled grating exposure duration in milliseconds; changing it changes the stimulus phase, not measured photon timing.

fields.label: Grating centre eccentricity (left/right)
fields.help_text: Positive angular distance from fixation. Left and right targets use opposite signs.

fields.label: Gaussian grating envelope sigma
fields.help_text: Gaussian standard deviation, not a hard radius; the grating smoothly fades to background at the separately selected cutoff.

fields.label: Grating outer edge (multiples of sigma)
fields.help_text: Support radius = sigma × cutoff; diameter = 2 × sigma × cutoff. The taper occupies the outer one sigma, so 1.5 is valid (radius 1.5° and width 3° at sigma 1°). Exact background outside support.

fields.label: Independent staircases per frequency
fields.help_text: Number of independently updated adaptive staircases in each scientific condition. More staircases divide accepted responses across more adaptive tracks.

fields.label: Starting digital modulation
fields.help_text: Initial digital peak-to-peak grating modulation for adaptive tracks. The carrier amplitude before its envelope is half this value; it is not measured optical contrast.

fields.label: Digital background (requires measured calibration for acquisition)
fields.help_text: Digital background command on the normalized zero-to-one scale. It changes available stimulus headroom; photometric calibration is required to interpret emitted luminance.

fields.label: Consecutive correct answers before decreasing contrast
fields.help_text: Consecutive correct responses required before a downward strength step. Increasing this count delays downward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Consecutive incorrect answers before increasing contrast
fields.help_text: Consecutive incorrect responses required before an upward strength step. Increasing this count delays upward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Contrast increase (log10 units)
fields.help_text: Upward step in base-10 logarithmic strength units: multiply the controlled strength by 10 raised to this value, subject to the method bounds.

fields.label: Contrast decrease (log10 units)
fields.help_text: Downward step in base-10 logarithmic strength units: divide the controlled strength by 10 raised to this value, subject to the method bounds.

fields.label: Initial one-down responses (0 disables; default)
fields.help_text: Maximum initial accepted responses per staircase using a one-correct downward rule. The first incorrect response ends this phase early; subsequent responses use the selected consecutive-correct rule. Zero disables the initial phase.

fields.label: Reversals required per staircase
fields.help_text: Reversal count required to complete each adaptive staircase. A reversal is a change of step direction; the safety ceiling can stop the run before this goal.

fields.label: Final reversals used for the threshold median
fields.help_text: Number of final eligible reversal values included in the declared threshold summary. Too few eligible reversals makes that estimator unavailable.

fields.label: Software safety ceiling (not scientific completion)
fields.help_text: Accepted-response safety ceiling used by the selected adaptive/fixed method. Fixed plans exceeding it are rejected; adaptive stopping at this ceiling does not establish threshold convergence.

fields.label: Response keys (in alternative order: left, right)
fields.help_text: Keys assigned in the displayed response-alternative order. Changing a key changes input mapping, not which alternative is scientifically correct.

scientific_spec.response: Left or right grating location; researcher-selected offset and target/response alternative equality.
scientific_spec.quantity: Digital peak-to-peak grating modulation; not optical Michelson contrast.
scientific_spec.conditions: TUI frequency list; independent staircases, uniform active selection, independent equiprobable target sides.
scientific_spec.adaptive: TUI-selected consecutive n-down/n-up log10 changes, initial phase and reversal limit. No guaranteed target probability for arbitrary settings.
scientific_spec.stopping: Each staircase completes at its reversal limit; global response ceiling is incomplete termination.
scientific_spec.exclusions: No post-hoc response exclusion. Timeout/abort/errors preserve accepted input. Adaptive strength saturates at the declared digital bound (flat holds are not reversals); invalid physical renderer commands are rejected without silent clipping.
scientific_spec.estimator: Median final TUI-selected presented reversal contrasts per complete staircase; mean across all configured staircases of a complete frequency.

fields.label: Probe centre above/below fixation (required)
fields.help_text: Distance from fixation to probe centre, not pixels or total separation. At x=0, a displacement smaller than half the selected probe length puts the line across fixation. For an appearance check, try 0.2 degrees; choose the study value yourself.

fields.label: Flanker spatial frequency (required)
fields.help_text: Spatial frequency of the flanker grating in cycles per visual degree. This changes the flanker pattern and its sampling requirements, not the probe condition coordinates.

fields.label: Contrast selection method
fields.help_text: Adaptive retains the study's original staircase; constant stimuli presents preselected digital probe increments.

fields.label: Fixed digital probe increments
fields.help_text: Comma-separated absolute digital increments I_probe-I_background, not measured optical contrast or absolute intensity.

fields.label: Trials per level per scientific condition
fields.help_text: Condition means probe position/ellipse/ring configuration, not independent staircase replicate. Target intervals/sides are seeded and balanced.

fields.label: Response keys (in alternative order: above, below)
fields.help_text: Keys assigned in the displayed response-alternative order. Changing a key changes input mapping, not which alternative is scientifically correct.

scientific_spec.boundary_policy: Saturate adaptive strength at the digital gamut bound; flat holds are not reversals. Positive float floor prevents log underflow. Boundary-affected estimates are flagged, not qualified thresholds.
scientific_spec.response: Is the line above or below fixation?
scientific_spec.quantity: Digital line increment above background; optical contrast requires measured calibration.
scientific_spec.conditions: TUI-selected horizontal probe positions; independently interleaved repeat staircases and equiprobable above/below targets.
scientific_spec.adaptive: TUI n-down/n-up and log10 steps; reversal direction starts at the actual initial presentation, holds ignored.
scientific_spec.stopping: Reversal completion; global ceiling is incomplete, not a successful threshold.
scientific_spec.estimator: Geometric mean final retained presented reversals; mean across all complete repeats.
scientific_spec.geometry: Probe width/length come from the selected DetectionScene parameters; displacement is an experiment setting. Flanker 5 degree square at x=-3 degrees; digital peak-to-peak modulation .018; frequency selected independently by the researcher.

fields.label: Fixation duration
fields.help_text: Scheduled fixation phase duration before the stimulus, in milliseconds; this is not a measured photon-onset duration.

fields.label: Stimulus interval duration
fields.help_text: Scheduled stimulus exposure duration in milliseconds; changing it changes the trial timeline, not measured display qualification.

fields.label: Independent staircases per condition
fields.help_text: Number of independently updated adaptive staircases in each scientific condition. More staircases divide accepted responses across more adaptive tracks.

fields.label: Starting probe intensity
fields.help_text: 0 = black; 1 = white. This bright-probe task uses intensity at or above background. The staircase changes the difference from background, not absolute intensity. Ring/flanker overlap uses the scene's additive headroom; see the resolved range below.

fields.label: Background intensity
fields.help_text: Digital background command on the normalized zero-to-one scale. It changes available stimulus headroom; photometric calibration is required to interpret emitted luminance.

fields.label: Consecutive correct answers before a decrease
fields.help_text: Consecutive correct responses required before a downward strength step. Increasing this count delays downward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Consecutive errors before an increase
fields.help_text: Consecutive incorrect responses required before an upward strength step. Increasing this count delays upward steps; it does not change the selected step magnitude.

fields.label: Increase in probe difference from background
fields.help_text: Multiply the probe-background difference by 10**step; hold at the upper bound.

fields.label: Decrease in probe difference from background
fields.help_text: Multiply the probe-background difference by 10**(-step); this approaches background, rather than subtracting the step from intensity.

fields.label: Initial one-down responses (0 disables)
fields.help_text: Maximum initial accepted responses per staircase using a one-correct downward rule. The first incorrect response ends this phase early; subsequent responses use the selected consecutive-correct rule. Zero disables the initial phase.

fields.label: Reversals per staircase
fields.help_text: Reversal count required to complete each adaptive staircase. A reversal is a change of step direction; the safety ceiling can stop the run before this goal.

fields.label: Final reversals retained for threshold
fields.help_text: Number of final eligible reversal values included in the declared threshold summary. Too few eligible reversals makes that estimator unavailable.

fields.label: Global safety ceiling; reaching it is incomplete
fields.help_text: Accepted-response safety ceiling used by the selected adaptive/fixed method. Fixed plans exceeding it are rejected; adaptive stopping at this ceiling does not establish threshold convergence.

fields.label: Gap between intervals
fields.help_text: Scheduled silent/blank gap between the two stimulus intervals, in milliseconds; it changes their temporal separation.

fields.label: Ring digital increment (study choice; required)
fields.help_text: Ring pixels = background + increment, not absolute intensity or measured luminance. Range 0 to 1-background; probe overlap can reduce local headroom. Ignored for absent rings.

fields.label: Ellipse b/a ratios
fields.help_text: Comma-separated ratios from 0.5 to 1; each ratio defines a condition.

fields.label: Ellipse and probe centre vertical position
fields.help_text: Common y coordinate of ellipse and probe, relative to fixation; 0 is fixation.

fields.label: Ellipse outer horizontal radius
fields.help_text: Outer semi-major axis of the ellipse; aspect ratio sets the vertical semi-axis.

fields.label: Interval onset cues
fields.help_text: Enable the experiment-declared auditory interval cues. This does not establish measured audio/display synchronization.

fields.label: Cue frequency (study choice)
fields.help_text: Requested tone frequency of the auditory cue, in hertz; it changes the cue pitch.

fields.label: Cue duration (study choice)
fields.help_text: Requested auditory cue duration in milliseconds; physical audio onset and duration require independent qualification.

fields.label: Contrast selection method
fields.help_text: Adaptive retains the study's original staircase; constant stimuli presents preselected digital probe increments.

fields.label: Fixed digital probe increments
fields.help_text: Comma-separated absolute digital increments I_probe-I_background, not measured optical contrast or absolute intensity.

fields.label: Trials per level per scientific condition
fields.help_text: Condition means probe position/ellipse/ring configuration, not independent staircase replicate. Target intervals/sides are seeded and balanced.

fields.label: Response keys (in alternative order: first, second)
fields.help_text: Keys assigned in the displayed response-alternative order. Changing a key changes input mapping, not which alternative is scientifically correct.

scientific_spec.response: Which temporal interval contains the line; first/second.
scientific_spec.quantity: Digital line increment above background; optical contrast requires measured calibration.
scientific_spec.conditions: TUI-selected aspect ratios and ellipse vertical centre; line is at ellipse centre x=0; independently interleaved repeat staircases and equiprobable first/second targets.
scientific_spec.adaptive: TUI n-down/n-up and log10 steps; reversal direction starts at the actual initial presentation, holds ignored.
scientific_spec.stopping: Reversal completion; global ceiling is incomplete, not a successful threshold.
scientific_spec.estimator: Median final retained presented reversals; mean across all complete repeats.
scientific_spec.geometry: Degrees; probe dimensions are selected stimulus parameters; ring uses nested ellipses with .16 degree axial inset, requiring visual qualification.
